name: looksift
description: Choose numbered style, palette, outfit or layout references on Looksift, then use them for prompts and images with the host's image tool.

interface.longDescription: Choose a numbered style, palette, outfit or layout reference on Looksift and bring it to your Agent. Any one kind is enough. A selected style has two independent Qwen/GPT reference versions; outfit edits preserve the supplied person's identity and pose. A capable client generates images. Without drawing or the required reference-image inputs, the Agent delivers full prompts, real reference download links, input order and brief usage steps. The remote MCP provides the official prompt templates and public reference data; it needs no login and does not generate images. Responses follow your language and prompt-only never draws. Pose, action, expression, monster and private collections are outside this version. Layout L-numbers provide composition and typography references in four languages. Adapt them to your own subject and exact quoted text; the reference does not fix your output aspect ratio.
defaultPrompt: How do I use Looksift? Show me where to choose style, palette, outfit or layout references.
Use Looksift style 47 for a seaside bookshop. Write only the prompts in my language; do not generate images.
Use Looksift layout L0001 for a coffee launch poster with the title "MORNING".
